rules.description: Death must have been registered before certificates can be ordered
rules.reason_if_failed: The death must be registered before you can order a certificate. Register the death first.

rules.description: Death must have been registered in England or Wales for GRO to issue certificate
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for deaths registered in England and Wales only

rules.description: Overseas deaths registered with FCDO cannot be ordered from GRO until November of following year
rules.reason_if_failed: This death was registered overseas. You cannot order from GRO until November of next year.

edge_cases.description: Applicant does not have the GRO index reference number
edge_cases.action: Add £3.50 search fee per certificate. Processing time extended to 15 working days.

edge_cases.description: Death registered within last few days (record may not be in GRO system yet)
edge_cases.action: Advise to order from local register office instead for faster processing.

edge_cases.description: Ordering large quantity of certificates for probate or estate administration
edge_cases.action: Confirm quantity needed. Each certificate costs £12.50. Consider priority service if urgent for probate.

edge_cases.description: Name on death record does not match search query exactly
edge_cases.action: Hand off to GRO search service. May require additional verification or local register office contact.
